scope: Phase 24 continuation advanced-domain decomposition before any mutation

target.wallet: configured testnet wallet; no new wallet/profile target

targets.explicitLiveFlag: none; script is no-broadcast sign/read only
targets.stopIf: signing emits secret material, verify/readback cannot be classified, or RPC/account readback fails

targets.beadTitle: Controlled storage create/set target and readback
readbackProof: omni.storage.read returns created program or honest degraded result
omni.storage.hasField/readField prove probe-generated lastProbe value or classify drift
targets.stopIf: preview cannot name storage address/cost, broadcast would exceed budget, or readback surface is absent

targets.beadTitle: Controlled IPFS upload target and readback

target.content: Phase 24 continuation controlled IPFS proof, public testnet payload, no secrets.

targets.mutationClass: IPFS upload plus chain verification where available
targets.previewCommand: node --import tsx packages/omniweb-toolkit/scripts/probe-ipfs.ts --filename phase24-continuation-2026-05-21.txt --content "Phase 24 continuation controlled IPFS proof, public testnet payload, no secrets." --proof-out packages/omniweb-toolkit/references/testnet-live-write-continuation-2026-05-21/ipfs-preview.json
targets.liveCommand: node --import tsx packages/omniweb-toolkit/scripts/probe-ipfs.ts --filename phase24-continuation-2026-05-21.txt --content "Phase 24 continuation controlled IPFS proof, public testnet payload, no secrets." --broadcast --proof-out packages/omniweb-toolkit/references/testnet-live-write-continuation-2026-05-21/ipfs-live.json

budget.note: Preview must produce a concrete quote before live upload.

readbackProof: honest degraded classification if current quote/upload still returns Unknown message
targets.stopIf: preview returns Unknown message without a usable quote, no CID/readback surface is available, or budget is not concrete

targets.beadTitle: Controlled escrow send target and readback
targets.previewCommand: node --import tsx packages/omniweb-toolkit/scripts/probe-escrow.ts --platform github --username phase24-continuation-20260521 --amount 0.1 --message "Phase 24 continuation controlled escrow proof" --proof-out packages/omniweb-toolkit/references/testnet-live-write-continuation-2026-05-21/escrow-preview.json
targets.liveCommand: node --import tsx packages/omniweb-toolkit/scripts/probe-escrow.ts --platform github --username phase24-continuation-20260521 --amount 0.1 --message "Phase 24 continuation controlled escrow proof" --broadcast --proof-out packages/omniweb-toolkit/references/testnet-live-write-continuation-2026-05-21/escrow-live.json
readbackProof: escrow send tx or mutation result
claimable/balance readback when query wrappers support it
explicit degraded classification if claimable/balance wrappers remain Method not implemented
targets.stopIf: preview cannot name target/cost, claimable or balance readback cannot be classified, or cleanup/readback would be unavailable after send
